title: A library for differentiable signal processing and machine learning on the sphere
abstract: arXiv:2609.39737v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The two-dimensional sphere embedded in three-dimensional Euclidean space S2, plays a central role in a variety of scientific and engineering domains, including geophysics, planetary science, geodesy, atmospheric physics, quantum chemistry, cosmology, and virtual reality, among many others. As machine learning increasingly permeates these fields, the demand grows for robust tools that process and model functions on the sphere, while respecting the inherent topological and symmetry properties of the domain. We present torch-harmonics, a comprehensive library that offers efficient, differentiable implementations of advanced signal processing and machine learning (ML) methods for spherical data. These include the spherical harmonic transform (SHT), the spherical analogue of the Fourier transform, vector spherical harmonics, discrete-continuous and spectral convolutions, as well as both global and neighborhood spherical attention mechanisms.

translated_title: 一个用于球面上可微信号处理与机器学习的库
translated_abstract: 嵌入三维欧几里得空间中的二维球面 S² 在众多科学和工程领域扮演着核心角色，包括地球物理学、行星科学、大地测量学、大气物理学、量子化学、宇宙学和虚拟现实等。随着机器学习日益渗透到这些领域，人们对于能够在处理和建模球面上函数的同时，尊重该领域固有拓扑与对称性质的稳健工具的需求不断增长。我们提出了 torch-harmonics，这是一个功能全面的库，为球面数据提供了先进信号处理和机器学习方法的高效、可微实现。这些方法包括球谐变换（SHT，即傅里叶变换在球面上的对应形式）、向量球谐函数、离散-连续卷积和谱卷积，以及全局和邻域球面注意力机制。
tldr: 本文提出了 torch-harmonics 库，为球面数据提供高效可微的信号处理与机器学习方法实现，涵盖球谐变换、球面卷积以及全局和邻域球面注意力机制。
en_tdlr: This paper presents torch-harmonics, a comprehensive library providing efficient, differentiable implementations of advanced signal processing and machine learning methods for spherical data, including spherical harmonic transforms, spherical convolutions, and global and neighborhood spherical attention mechanisms.
